rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken pattern when something is done incorrectly or in the wrong way.

example.english: You did your homework improperly, so read the questions carefully and do it again.
example.traditional: 你份功課做得唔啱，睇清楚題目先再做啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan6 gung1 fo3 zou6 dak1 m4 ngaam1 tai2 cing1 co2 tai4 muk6 sin1 zoi3 zou6 laa1

rows.note: Use this when the improper action is socially, morally, or situationally unacceptable rather than merely technically incorrect.

example.english: You improperly interrupt people when they are speaking.
example.traditional: 你唔應該喺人哋講嘢嗰陣打斷人哋。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 jing1 goi1 hai2 jan4 dei6 gong2 je5 go2 zan6 daa2 tyun5 jan4 dei6
